comment: Save-and-restore variation of nested-subroom-level-teleport-return: restore.c dorecover() reads the hero's own level through getlev() -> mkroom.c rest_rooms() (893-906) -> rest_room() (875-886), instead of goto_level() reading a level the hero returns to. Seed 4170006's Dlvl 1 has themerms.lua 'Nesting rooms' with the outer room at (3,6)-(14,17), its subroom at (5,9)-(14,14) and that subroom's own subroom at (13,11)-(14,12) (port-only scanSeeds() probe over 4170001-4170400, first of 3 hits). The debug-mode Archeologist saves on Dlvl 1 at once; the second segment restores, declines to keep the save file, and searches twice. Seeds, datetimes, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session and batch game.
